event.description: training-control ordinal probe 3, pre-dataset stop after setup-cost diagnosis
event.proposal: Family: training control. Retained incumbent is 6080 parameters at 100.00%, with 1.00 percentage point margin over 99%. Most recent same-family evidence is attempt-0002, an optimization failure at 2 steps; prior attempts in this family: 2. This ordinal-3 probe records the diagnosed infrastructure boundary that tiny runs still pay dataset setup cost, using a distinct logged stop ordinal; it is more informative than repeating the interrupted training because it isolates runner/training startup from optimization. Classification is infrastructure/optimization diagnostic; no score is inferred, no candidate is retained, and runner rollback remains authoritative.
